title: Vakaviti Transfer Core — canonical contracts, v1
description: Versioned shared contracts for the Vakaviti Transfer Core (Issue #37/#38). v1 is additive-only over each storefront's current shape — nothing here requires a storefront to change its live API today. Each storefront maps its existing values INTO these shapes at the Fare Authority boundary; it does not need to natively speak them yet.

Place.description: A canonical, deduplicated location. Storefronts 1/2's per-hotel granularity and storefront 3's corridor granularity both resolve to Place rows; a Place may represent one hotel OR a named corridor grouping several, distinguished by placeKind.

placeId.description: Canonical Vakaviti place id, e.g. plc_hilton-denarau.

canonicalRouteAnchor.description: Which zone/corridor this place resolves to for pricing purposes (Vakaviti Route Authority key), e.g. 'Denarau'.

memberOf.description: For placeKind=hotel, the corridor Place this hotel rolls up into, if any (storefront-3-style grouping).

Route.description: An origin/destination pair at the pricing-resolution level (not per-hotel). Today every live route observed across all three storefronts is Nadi-Airport-anchored; the schema does not hardcode that assumption.

VehicleClass.description: Canonical vehicle class. storefronts 1/2 and storefront 3 currently share the same three label strings by coincidence, not by contract — this schema makes that an explicit, versioned mapping instead of an assumption.

isMarketplaceOnly.description: True for classes only fulfilled via marketplace supply (e.g. boat today).

storefrontId.description: See BookingSource — which storefront is asking.

operatorPayoutFjd.description: Never sent to the guest-facing client. Present only on the internal/server-side copy of this contract.

clientBookingRef.description: Storefront's own idempotency key / display ref (FD-XXXXXX today, or a UUID) — preserved verbatim, never replaced.

vakavitiBookingId.description: New canonical cross-storefront id. Never replaces the storefront's own reference; always issued alongside it.

BookingSource.description: Adopted from bookfijitransfers.com's existing attribution object — the most complete of the three storefronts' current models. Storefronts 1/2 currently send none of this; v1 treats every field as optional so nothing breaks, but a real cutover should start populating it.

fullName.description: Canonical single field. Storefront 3's firstName/lastName split is concatenated on ingest; split is preserved in rawSource if needed.

airline.description: Not captured by any storefront today — placeholder for future flight-status integration (Issue #37 agent layer).

ReturnTrip.description: v1 keeps the existing single-record model (matches all three storefronts today) rather than forcing a MultiLegJourney split. MultiLegJourney is reserved for Issue #37 Stage F (multimodal/through-journey) and is intentionally NOT required yet.

returnDiscountModel.description: Storefronts 1/2 use a 1.85x return multiplier; storefront 3 uses a flat 5% discount on the second leg. These are NOT equivalent — do not assume a shared return price without recomputing per-storefront.

MultiLegJourney.description: Reserved for Issue #37 Stage F. Not populated by any storefront today.

OperatorPayout.description: Deliberately separate from RetailFare per Issue #37's core commercial rule. Never exposed to a guest-facing response.

marginFjd.description: retailFareFjd - payoutFjd, computed at settlement, not stored on the guest-facing booking record.

StorefrontReference.description: The storefront's own public-facing reference, preserved verbatim forever. This is the field staff and guests actually use day to day; VK-... is additive, not a replacement.

referenceFormat.description: Human-readable description of the format, e.g. 'FD- + 6 uppercase alphanumeric'.
